entries.s: Camo needs detection. Towers without it won't shoot them.
Lead needs non-sharp damage. Darts can't.
Purple ignores Energy, Fire and Plasma.
Black ignores explosions. Zebra ignores explosions and ice.
White ignores ice. Frozen Bloons can't be popped by sharp attacks.
Fortified is just more HP. Every tower can pop it.
Almost every attack hurts a MOAB. You need damage, not a special key.
A DDT is camo + Lead + Black, and fast. One tower must handle all three.
